 Skuld names new underwriting chief and CFO
 Oct 23, 2026 
 Norway-based Assuranceforeningen Skuld (Gjensidig) has promoted Chief Financial Officer Kristian Løberg to chief underwriting officer, Coverager reported. Skuld expects the reorganization to establish larger business units with expanded market oversight and sharpen coordination across regional offices and product lines.
